title.en: Which printed window fits this check: what mortar window does the plunger sprayer print
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：柱塞式砂浆喷涂机印了哪一扇窗口

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Mortar inside 4 m³/h and ≤ 8 mm, on 380 V. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the double-cylinder plunger sprayer at 9/11 kW dual motors, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, 1850 × 545 × 605 mm and 420 kg. Taken from the printed row: It is not Type 311 and not a concrete pump.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。砂浆在 4 m³/h 和 ≤ 8 mm 内，并且有 380V。邢台河北品锦机械把双缸柱塞式喷涂机印成双电机 9/11 kW、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、水平 100 m / 垂直 40 m、外形 1850 × 545 × 605 mm、420 kg。它不是 311，也不是混凝土泵。

Taken from the printed row: It is not Type 311 and not a concrete pump.

body.en: This block keeps the heading “History” from “Plasterwork”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 380 V, 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤ 8 mm, 100 m / 40 m, 420 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The hydraulic concrete sprayer is 5 m³/h, 7.5/9 kW, ≤ 8 mm and 100 m / 50 m at 295 kg. Taken from the printed row: The diesel concrete sprayer at 5 m³/h allows ≤ 6 mm, not the plunger’s ≤ 8 mm. Keep this cell as published. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Yes, as printed. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plasterwork
body.zh: 本节保留《Plasterwork》的标题“沿革”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。380V、9/11 kW、4 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤ 8 mm、100 m / 40 m、420 kg。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plasterwork

body.en: The section shape comes from “Tools and materials” in “Plasterwork”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Mortar inside 4 m³/h and ≤ 8 mm, on 380 V. Taken from the printed row: The plunger is 4 m³/h, 9/11 kW, 100 m / 40 m and 420 kg. Keep this cell as published. There is no diesel version of this plunger printed in the catalogue. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Read it in the Xingtai table. No.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Plasterwork》的“用具用料”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：砂浆在 4 m³/h 和 ≤ 8 mm 内，并且有 380V。邢台河北品锦机械把双缸柱塞式喷涂机印成双电机 9/11 kW、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、水平 100 m / 垂直 40 m、外形 1850 × 545 × 605 mm、420 kg。它不是 311，也不是混凝土泵。目录里已经写着：不是。水平是 100 m。垂直是 40 m。

body.en: “Plasterwork” breaks its subject at “Methods”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the double-cylinder plunger sprayer at 9/11 kW dual motors, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤ 1:3, 100 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, 1850 × 545 × 605 mm and 420 kg. Keep this cell as published. Match the output and the vertical cell, not the shared ≤ 8 mm phrase alone. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send particle size and hose length. Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Taken from the printed row: The particle cell is ≤ 8 mm.
body.zh: 《Plasterwork》在“方法”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：511 是 3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、32/38 mm、≤ 6 mm。液压混凝土喷涂机是 5 m³/h、7.5/9 kW、≤ 8 mm、100 m / 50 m、295 kg。柱塞机是 4 m³/h、9/11 kW、100 m / 40 m、420 kg。要对照输送量和垂直格，不要只看共同的 ≤ 8 mm。这一格照已印出的读：印了。

body.en: Borrow “Plastering” from “Plasterwork” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. It is not Type 311 and not a concrete pump. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page requires 380 V for 9/11 kW. Read it in the Xingtai table. 100 m / 40 m is the printed limit. Taken from the printed row: Horizontal is 100 m.
body.zh: 把《Plasterwork》的“抹灰”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：这一页要求 380V 供给 9/11 kW。3 m³/h 的柴油砂浆替代是 511 柴油机。5 m³/h 的柴油混凝土喷涂机允许 ≤ 6 mm，不是柱塞机的 ≤ 8 mm。目录里没有这台柱塞机的柴油版。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不能。粒径格是 ≤ 8 mm。

body.en: The reference page “Plasterwork” uses “Examples” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Type 511 is 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 32/38 mm and ≤ 6 mm. Read it in the Xingtai table. The diesel mortar alternative at 3 m³/h is Type 511 diesel. Taken from the printed row: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Keep this cell as published. Vertical is 40 m.
body.zh: 来源页《Plasterwork》用“实例”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请发送粒径和软管长度。100 m / 40 m 是已印上限。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “History” — Is 40 m horizontal?
question.zh: “沿革”旁边仍要印着的是什么：40 m 是水平吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. Horizontal is 100 m. Vertical is 40 m.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。水平是 100 m。垂直是 40 m。

question.en: “Tools and materials” does not change the check: Is the drive described as all-copper dual motor?
question.zh: “用具用料”不改这一问：驱动写成全铜双电机了吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes, as printed.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：印了。

question.en: Can it place 2 cm concrete, once the outline says “Methods”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“方法”时，它能浇 2 cm 混凝土吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. The particle cell is ≤ 8 mm.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不能。粒径格是 ≤ 8 mm。
